title: Enforce npm dependency release age
summary: Require root npm dependency resolution to quarantine package releases for seven days.
reason: The compatibility-floor change introduced a project .npmrc without npm's release-age supply-chain control, which GitHub Advanced Security reported as Semgrep alert 2114.
behavior_before: Root npm tooling enforced its Node engine floor but could resolve a dependency immediately after publication.
behavior_after: Root npm tooling rejects dependency versions published less than seven days ago while preserving the existing locked dependency graph.
manual_validation: PASS: npm 11.12.1 loaded the project min-release-age=7 policy as the effective relative before cutoff while preserving engine-strict=true.
PASS: npm ci completed against the locked 88-package dependency graph under the seven-day policy.
PASS: npm audit --audit-level=moderate reported zero vulnerabilities.
PASS: complete npm run webview:prework:check with 1,397/1,402 ESLint warnings and zero errors.
rollback_plan: Remove min-release-age from .npmrc and rerun npm configuration, clean install, audit, and WebView prework validation.
notes: Seven days follows GitHub Advanced Security's finding guidance and npm's documented day-based min-release-age semantics. No dependency, lint rule, audit, or release gate is exempted.
